## Services
- Confirmed by the Google listing and reviews: mechanical auto repair, diagnosis, oil change, routine maintenance, alternator replacement, repairs after a breakdown.
- Listed on their original website (call to confirm they are still offered): auto body repair; car wash, wash & wax and full detail; seat and carpet shampoo; seat and carpet dye (spot dye too). "We do them all from compact cars to 18 wheelers, RV's, and boats."
- Pickup and delivery if requested, only within a 5-mile radius (original website).

## Specials (original website; call to confirm)
- Every day the 15th customer wins a free $50 gas card or $25 cash (customer's choice).
- Teacher, military and senior-citizen discounts.
- Ladies' Day discount every day (car wash, cars only); Men's Day discount Mondays and Wednesdays.

## Google reviews (verbatim, five-star selection)
- Shewania Moore (a month ago, 5 stars): "I had a wonderful experience with this auto shop! Kenny took the time to carefully explain everything my vehicle needed,showed me the areas that needed attention, and made sure I understood the importance of each service. I truly appreciated his honesty, patience, and professionalism throughout the process. As a woman, it is especially important to feel comfortable, respected, and secure when taking your vehicle in for services. He provided that extra level of reassurance by being transparent, informative,and never making me uncomfortable asking questions. I felt confident that my vehicle was in good hands. It's refreshing to find an auto shop that values customer service, honesty, and making sure customers feel informed rather than overwhelmed. I highly recommend this shop to anyone looking for quality service, clear communication, and a mechanic along with his team you can trust. I will definitely be returning for future automotive needs! Thank you! Kenny, Kasey, and Michelle! Simply Amazing!"
- Anthony Zimlich (a year ago (edited), 5 stars): "Honesty, integrity and professionalism are just a few words to describe Quiet Storm. I can not say enough great things about this shop. My vehicle was towed there after it catastrophically broke down and they diagnosed and fixed the problems with little to no visible malfunctions. They showed me what the problem was, explained it thoroughly and was spot on with the time required to fix it. The shop is impeccably clean, friendly and restores my faith in honest workmanship. Being from out of town, they communicated incredibly and charged me a very fair price. The receptionist/office manager (Michelle) and owner himself (Kenny) treated me like family and they pay attention to the small details. I'll make the two hour drive in a heartbeat just to use this shop again. 10 stars!"
